quaver.definition:
n. a tremulous sound
v. give off unsteady sounds, alternating in amplitude or frequency
quaver.translation:
vi. 发颤音, 颤抖
vt. 颤抖地说, 用颤声唱出
n. 颤抖, 颤声, 八分音符

quavered.translation: v. 发颤音, （声音或音乐）颤抖( quaver的过去式和过去分词 ); 用颤抖的声音说

quaverer.definition: n. One who quavers; a warbler.

quavering.definition: s. (of the voice) quivering as from weakness or fear
quavering.translation: a. 颤抖的, 颤声的

quaveringly.definition: r in an unsteady quavering manner
quaveringly.translation: adv. 震动地, 颤音地

quavers.definition:
n a tremulous sound
n a musical note having the time value of an eighth of a whole note
v give off unsteady sounds, alternating in amplitude or frequency
v sing or play with trills, alternating with the half note above or below
quavers.translation: n. 颤音( quaver的名词复数 )

quavery.translation: a. 震音的, 颤声的
